title: So Much Potential
body: This game is fun. The idea, the strategies, the fact that you can gain football knowledge. It’s such a great concept, but the kicker for me is that you only get a limited number of games a day, which would be fine, but again you limit the limited number of games. Like how are you gonna allow me to play 5 ranked games, but then only allow me to play 3 free ranked games before you want me to spend money on tokens. I just don’t get why you limit your consumers and encourage them to buy your tokens only to not let them use them. Also, you can get “free” tokens but it’s only from like following on social media and you only get 3 tokens so those were gone in a day. Also, I don’t understand the accuracy, my target score is 115, I get 104 but 100% accuracy, does that just mean I put my card in the right place or did I pick all the best cards. SO MUCH MISSED OPPORTUNITIES!!! PLEASE UP DATED YOUR GAME! Like even if you bumped the limit to 10 games a day, it would be so much better.

title: Game of the Year
body: As someone who’s played fantasy football for years, I thought I’d seen every variation possible—then I found Griddy. What makes Griddy different is that it isn’t just another fantasy app. It’s a daily puzzle that rewards both football knowledge and strategy. Every pick matters, and balancing Talent and Chemistry creates decisions that are surprisingly challenging and incredibly satisfying when everything comes together. The card system is addictive, the player database is deep, and the daily format makes it easy to jump in for a few minutes while still feeling competitive. I love that success isn’t based purely on luck—you have to understand players, teams, divisions, and how to maximize your draft grade. The design is clean, fast, and easy to learn, but the gameplay has enough depth to keep me coming back every day. It’s one of those rare games that’s simple to pick up and difficult to master. If you’re a football fan who enjoys strategy, puzzles, and roster building, Griddy is an absolute gem. I’ve genuinely looked forward to playing each day, and that’s the highest compliment I can give any game. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
